//: Compiler settings for the per-plugin Playwright specs under integrations/<lane>/e2e/. Referenced by integrations/tooling/playwright.config.ts via its `tsconfig` option; not a build config, and deliberately not extended by any package tsconfig.json here. It carries no `paths`: bare `@playwright/test` and `@tomic/lib` imports resolve through the `integrations/node_modules` symlink that points at `browser/e2e/node_modules`, where both packages live as dependencies of the `@tomic/e2e` workspace package. Mapping them with `paths` instead broke CJS/ESM interop — `@playwright/test` is CommonJS, and a paths-resolved import of it fails with "Named export 'expect' not found".
